analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램은 개선 중이나 ADX 추세 강도 25.1로 추세 형성 초기 단계. 5일 저가 1,044,000원, 20일 저가 1,044,000원으로 Higher Low 패턴 미확인. 현재가 1,085,000원은 스윙 지지선 808,000원 대비 높은 수준이나, 스윙 저항선 1,099,000원 하단에 위치. 변동성 ATR 96,860원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(125,918원) 설정 시 진입가 1,085,000원, 손절 959,082원, 목표 1,300,000원. 그러나 추세 강도 약하고 Higher Low 미확인으로 매수 진입 근거 부족. 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has entered oversold territory, and while the MACD histogram is improving, the ADX trend strength is at 25.1, indicating an early stage of trend formation. The 5-day low of 1,044,000 won and 20-day low of 1,044,000 won do not confirm a Higher Low pattern. The current price of 1,085,000 won is above the swing support of 808,000 won but below the swing resistance of 1,099,000 won. With an ATR of 96,860 won, a 1.3x ATR stop loss (125,918 won) would set the entry at 1,085,000 won, stop at 959,082 won, and target at 1,300,000 won. However, the weak trend strength and unconfirmed Higher Low pattern lack sufficient grounds for a buy entry. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($1,639,754)/SMA200 ($1,529,958): Below long-term trends, maintaining strong weakness.
· 52-week position (29.9%) + Current price level is high relative to 52-week low but significantly lower than high, indicating historical context.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (35.7 → 36.5): Entering oversold territory, continuing weakness.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-4695.3966 → -2889.4814): Improving but still in negative territory, diagnosing bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $984,373): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 44.20% suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($1,099,000): Close to the current price, potential for a short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low 1,044,000 won, 20-day low 1,044,000 won): Higher Low unconfirmed, possibility of sideways movement or Lower High.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.13x): Normal level, indicating moderate confidence in the price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Insufficient grounds for buy entry, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
